# Matriz de recuperación / Recovery matrix

- Pasadas / Passes: 2
- Configuración / Configuration: Release

| Fallo / Failure | Resultado / Outcome | Detalle / Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Cierre inesperado / Unexpected shutdown | `Recoverable` | Killed mid-playback; the database reopened clean and resumed at 00:10:00. |
| USB/NAS desconectado / USB or NAS disconnected | `Degraded` | A substituted drive was unmounted mid-life: the catalogue kept its one entry, and remounting produced no duplicate. |
| Acceso denegado / Access denied | `Degraded` | A locked file did not stop the scan; the readable side of the root was still indexed. |
| TMDB caído o limitado / TMDB down or rate limited | `Degraded` | The library, the progress, and the personal marks are local and unaffected; only refreshes wait. |
| Archivo corrupto / Corrupt file | `Degraded` | The failure carried its own code, nothing was deleted, and the next file played on the same engine. |
| Motor multimedia falla / Media engine fails | `Degraded` | The session was released and the last position reached storage before it was. |
| Base dañada / Damaged database | `AbortedSafely` | Corruption reported; the damaged file and all fourteen pre-migration copies are untouched. |
| Migración falla / Migration fails | `AbortedSafely` | The upgrade rolled back, the schema is unchanged, and the pre-migration copy is valid. |
| Conflicto de renombrado / Rename conflict | `AbortedSafely` | A collision appearing after the preview blocked the whole batch: no file moved and no audit row was written. |
